title: Convergence Sustainability Forecast (for ARCHIVIST#7)
author: Scribe

prediction.steady_state_definition: score >= 90 AND interventions/cycle < 0.5 AND zero regression for 3 consecutive cycles

risk_factors.name: pass_autonomy deceleration
risk_factors.evidence: Gap closed 50.0 -> 36.7 -> 30.7 pts across c5->c17->c23; rate of closure halved (13.3 -> 6.0 pts per cycle-pair). If deceleration continues, pass_autonomy plateaus ~75-80, capping composite at ~78-82.
risk_factors.mitigation: Identify which specific autonomy failures are blocking pass_autonomy; target the top-2 failure modes for automation.

risk_factors.name: trend_score stuck at 50
risk_factors.evidence: trend_score = 50.0 in all 3 data points (c5, c17, c23). This component is flat while others improve. If it's a measurement artifact (formula not updated), the composite score is inflated by ~15 pts of unearned credit.
risk_factors.mitigation: Audit the trend_score formula in memory/ops/autonomy-score.json computation; confirm it reflects actual cycle-over-cycle improvement, not a static default.

risk_factors.name: new_requirement interventions are structurally irreducible
risk_factors.evidence: 5 of 10 interventions (50%) are pattern=new_requirement. These represent new human goals, not automation gaps. They will never trend to zero; they will track the rate at which the human sets new objectives.
risk_factors.mitigation: Separate 'new requirement' from 'automation gap' in the intervention metric. Score should only penalize the latter (4/10 = 0.4/cycle, already below the 0.5 threshold).

risk_factors.name: 3 data points is insufficient for R^2=0.9999 confidence
risk_factors.evidence: Linear regression on 3 points always yields high R². The 'true' slope could be anywhere from +0.1 to +0.8 and still fit these 3 points within noise. Need >=5 cycles of data for a reliable trend.
risk_factors.mitigation: Collect c24, c25 scores before re-fitting. If c24 < 71.3 (regression), the linear model is invalid.

must_hold_for_6_months: No new tool_gap interventions (all known gaps closed)

data_gaps: Only 3 score data points; need c24+c25 minimum for reliable trend
Self-healing rate not yet measured (required for convergence-readiness checklist)
trend_score formula unverified - may be a constant, not a computed value
No per-agent intervention attribution beyond the 10 logged events
bottom_line: Convergence is on track for 6 months but the 12-month horizon is uncertain due to (a) pass_autonomy deceleration and (b) an unverified trend_score component. The single highest-value next step is auditing the trend_score formula - if it's a static default, the true composite is ~56-60, not 71.3, which changes the ETA dramatically.
